name: bank_fraud
lines: Good morning, this is the security and fraud department at your bank.
We have detected suspicious wire transfer requests leaving your checking account this morning.
Someone has compromised your routing number and account access.
To protect your remaining savings, you must not tell anyone at the local branch.
Drive to your nearest Bitcoin ATM machine right now and withdraw your funds as cash.
We will deposit the cash into a secure federal insurance locker.
